sourceMarkup:
'''Buffs''' ---- '''Buffs''' are special abilities applied to towers, which make them stronger. Some towers can apply a certain '''Buff''' to all towers in its range, while some can only apply it to themselves, either passively or with an ability. There are also '''Debuffs''', which make the towers weaker.
